en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ali Bin Al Hakam, from Ali Bin Abu Hamza, from Abu Baseer, 
Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> has said:
‘The free would not be killed due to a slave, even if he kills him deliberately, but he would be fined his price and would be whipped with an intense whipping when he kills him deliberately’.
And he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘The wergild of the slave is his value’.
